Purchases in 2015  IF YEAR([TR TransDate]) = 2015 THEN [Purchases] END
Price per Item     [TR Subtotal]/[TR Quantity]        (use as AVG)
Sales per Customer SUM([TR Subtotal])/COUNTD([Ent EntityID])

Why: SUM(TR Subtotal) by site mixes sales, returns and purchases (CA ≈ $1B, meaningless). CA alone ≈ $323M purchases + $688M sales.

3. Core concepts

Dimension vs. Measure
Dimension = group by (names, codes, dates), above the gray line. Measure = aggregate (SUM/AVG/COUNT), below the line. Dimensions → GROUP BY, measures → SUM/AVG, like SQL/PivotTable.
Convert ID numbers to dimensions: TR TransNumber, TR Manager, TR EntityID, TR Item, Emp EmployeeID, Ent EntityID, Ent Zip, Mat Material, Prod Product. Keep as measures: TR Quantity, TR UnitPrice, TR Subtotal, TR Tax + 4 calc fields. Hide unused: Emp Order Approval Authority, Ent RelationshipManager.
Test: "Would I ever sum or average this?"
Discrete (blue) vs. Continuous (green)
Blue = headers / separate panes. Green = a real axis (needed for trend lines). Right-click pill → Discrete/Continuous.
Dates: date part vs. truncated
Date part (upper menu options): QUARTER([TR TransDate]) → all Q1s combined, only 4 positions.
Truncated (lower options, show year, e.g. "Q1 2014", "May 2014"): DATETRUNC('quarter',[TR TransDate]) → 16 quarters / 48 months.
Problems 6–10 need truncated quarter (16 points). If the axis shows only Q1–Q4 you picked the wrong one.
Click + on YEAR pill to drill down: year → quarter → month → day.
Marks card: mark type dropdown (Automatic/Bar/Line/Circle/Shape/Map…), Color, Size, Label (prints values), Detail (splits marks finer without new rows/columns), Tooltip (hover text). Show Me (top right) suggests chart types; hover a grayed one to see what it needs.
Filters: drag a field to Filters. Filters remove rows before calculated fields and table calcs (except FIXED LOD, which ignores dimension filters). Exclude nulls: right-click the null mark/header → Exclude, or uncheck Null in the filter. Show a filter on the view: right-click pill → Show Filter.
Axis edits (right-click axis → Edit Axis): rename title; Fixed range ("start at 14K" = Fixed start 14,000); Tick Marks tab (fixed increments, e.g. 1M); Independent axis ranges for each row or column. Same range to compare panes; independent to see change within a pane.

4. How-to recipes (the moves the test checks)

Dual axis
  1. Put 2 measures on Rows.
  2. Right-click the second pill/axis → Dual Axis.
  3. Right-click right axis → Synchronize Axis.
  4. Right-click right axis → uncheck Show Header (hides it).
  5. Set each measure's mark type on its own Marks tab (or the All tab).
  6. If Measure Names lands on Color automatically and you don't want it, drag it off.
  7. Move circles to the front: right-click the axis/pill → Move marks to front, or reorder the pills on Rows.
Quick table calc: Percent of Total
Right-click measure pill → Quick Table Calculation → Percent of Total. Then right-click → Compute Using (or Edit Table Calculation → Specific Dimensions).
OptionWhat adds to 100%
Table (across)each full row
Table (down)each full column
Table (across then down)whole table
Pane (down)each column within one pane
Celleach cell alone (all 100%)
Specific dimensionsticked = calculated across; unticked = held fixed, each gets its own 100%
Per-site material shares (P2): tick only Mat MaterialDescription so each site's 8 materials = 100%.
Verify: Edit Table Calculation → Show calculation assistance.
Other quick calcs: Running Total, Difference, Percent Difference, Rank, Percentile, YTD Total, Moving Average.
Trend line: right-click view → Trend Lines → Show (or Analytics pane → drag Trend Line). Linear default; also Log, Exponential, Power, Polynomial. Needs continuous axis. One line for all colors: Edit Trend Lines → uncheck "Allow a trend line per color". Remove from one series: Edit Trend Lines → uncheck that measure. Hover = equation, R², p-value; Describe Trend Model for details.
Forecast: right-click → Forecast → Show Forecast (or Analysis → Forecast). Uses exponential smoothing (recent data weighted more). Options: length (Automatic / Exactly N / Until), model (Automatic, Automatic without seasonality, Custom: additive/multiplicative trend and season), prediction interval 90/95/99%.
Reference line / band / distribution / box plot: right-click y-axis → Add Reference Line (or Analytics pane). Scope: Entire Table (one line), Per Pane, Per Cell. Value: Average, Median, Sum, Total, Min, Max, Constant. Label: None / Computation / Value / Custom. Band = between two values. Distribution = percentiles/quantiles/std dev (±2 SD = control chart).
Annotations: right-click a mark → Annotate → Mark (or Point/Area). Type text. Remove the box border / arrow: right-click annotation → Format → Border None, Line (arrow) None.
Labels: Marks Label button → "Show mark labels". Only Min & Max: Label → Marks to Label → Min/Max. Vertical labels: Label → Alignment → Direction (rotated). Format numbers: right-click pill → Format → Pane → Numbers → Percentage, 1 decimal.
Axis/field label tweaks: Rotate header text: right-click header → Rotate Label. Hide "Mat MaterialDescription" title: right-click field label → Hide Field Labels for Columns/Rows. Gridlines off: Format → Lines → Grid Lines None. Borders on bars: Color → Border. One blue palette: Color → Edit Colors → Blue.
Top N within each group (Tutorial 11 / P15)
  1. Rows: TR SiteCode, Emp LastName. Columns: SUM(Sales). Sort descending.
  2. Drag Sales to Columns again → Quick Table Calc → Rank.
  3. Edit Table Calc → Compute Using Pane (down) → rank restarts per site.
  4. Ctrl/Option-drag the rank pill to Filters → keep 1 to N.
  5. Remove the rank pill from Columns.
Alternative: INDEX().

5. LOD expressions (Level of Detail)

{ FIXED   [dim1],[dim2] : AGG([measure]) }   own grouping, ignores view
{ INCLUDE [dim]         : AGG([measure]) }   view grouping + dim (finer)
{ EXCLUDE [dim]         : AGG([measure]) }   view grouping − dim (coarser)
{ FIXED : AVG([Sales]) }                      no dims = one grand number
  • Use a colon, not a semicolon. Curly braces.
  • FIXED ignores dimension filters (e.g. NY site filter) and dims in view. INCLUDE/EXCLUDE respect filters.
  • If it shows as ATTR, right-click → Measure → Average.
  • FIXED/INCLUDE finer than view → view takes an average of averages ≠ plain average.

Tutorial 10 examples (view: site, employee, month; filter TransType = O; AVG unit price):

{EXCLUDE [Emp LastName] : AVG([TR UnitPrice])}            site avg per month
{INCLUDE [TR Item] : AVG([TR UnitPrice])}                avg of per-item avgs
{FIXED [TR SiteCode],[TR TransType] : AVG([TR UnitPrice])} flat per site

Ref line vs. LOD: ref lines can do per-pane or entire-table averages, but not "each employee vs. their site's average". That needs an LOD.

8. Fast troubleshooting / traps

Percentages don't add to 100% per site → wrong Compute Using. Tick only the dimension you want to run across (material).
Only Q1–Q4 on x-axis → you used date part; switch to truncated quarter (with year).
Record count ≠ 258,602 after joins → an inner join should be left (Material/Product), or the wrong column was matched.
Calc says invalid → check quotes on text, no quotes on numbers, END at the end, brackets match field names, LOD uses colon.

MGT 153 · Module 3 Tableau: Skills Test Cheat Sheet

Built from the Tutorials 1–11 PDF, the Problems 1–16 PDF, and the actual data in "Tableau Workbook with Data Loaded" (all numbers below were computed from that data and match the solution screenshots). Dataset: fictional hip-implant maker, 5 sites (CA, FL, IL, NY, TX), 2012–2015.

1. The data in 60 seconds

Tables (star schema, Transactions in the center)
FileRowsHolds
Transactions.txt258,6021 row per purchase or sale
Sites.txt5site code + state name
Employee Master57managers: name, site, position
Entity Master1,072customers (S) / suppliers (O)
Material Master8raw materials
Product Master6finished hip implants
Joins
TableTypeOn
SitesInnerTR SiteCode = Site SiteCode
Employee MasterInnerTR Manager = Emp EmployeeID
Entity MasterInnerTR EntityID = Ent EntityID
Material MasterLeftTR Item = Mat Material
Product MasterLeftTR Item = Prod Product
Why Left: a purchase's TR Item is a material, a sale's is a product, never both. Inner on Material → only 11,268 rows (all sales lost).
TR TransType: S = sale (to customer), O = purchase order (from supplier). Return = sale row with negative TR Subtotal.
Rows: 247,334 sale + 11,268 purchase = 258,602. Return rows: 2,680.
Two sale rows (returns, 10/19/2015) have TR Item 7053, not in Product Master → need Left join.
Check figures (validation)
Records 258,602 · TR TransDate min 1/1/2012, max 12/31/2015 · TR CompleteDate min 1/3/2012, max 1/20/2016
SUM TR Quantity 1,168,069,907.55 · TR UnitPrice 2,047,028.33 · TR Subtotal 5,058,319,249.64 · TR Tax 354,113,001.27
Dates look wrong? File → Workbook Locale → English (US).
Products (6): Metal-on-Metal Hip (Titanium / Cobalt chrome / Stainless steel), Metal and Plastic Hip, Metal and Crosslinked Polyethylene Hip, Ceramic-on-Ceramic Hip.
Materials (8): Ceramic, Cobalt chrome, Plaster, Polyethylene (highly crosslinked), Polyethylene (standard grade), Silicone, Stainless steel, Titanium.
Sheet / Dashboard / Story. Sheet = one analysis. Dashboard = several sheets on one screen. Story = sheets/dashboards in sequence. Tabs at the bottom create each.

2. Calculated fields (Data pane ▾ → Create Calculated Field)

Sales      IF [TR TransType] = "S" AND [TR Subtotal] > 0 THEN [TR Subtotal] END
Returns    IF [TR Subtotal] < 0 THEN -[TR Subtotal] END
Net sales  IF [TR TransType] = "S" THEN [TR Subtotal] END
Purchases  IF [TR TransType] = "O" THEN [TR Subtotal] END
  • Sales = gross (positive sales only). Returns = negatives flipped positive (ABS also works). Net sales = sales minus returns (keeps negatives). Purchases = purchase orders.
  • No ELSE needed; other rows become null.
  • Text in "quotes"; numbers/years not quoted (= 2012, not "2012"). O is the letter O.
IF cond THEN result END
IF c1 THEN r1 ELSEIF c2 THEN r2 ELSE r3 END
Purchases in 2012  IF YEAR([TR TransDate]) = 2012 THEN [Purchases] END
Purchases in 2015  IF YEAR([TR TransDate]) = 2015 THEN [Purchases] END
Price per Item     [TR Subtotal]/[TR Quantity]        (use as AVG)
Sales per Customer SUM([TR Subtotal])/COUNTD([Ent EntityID])

Why: SUM(TR Subtotal) by site mixes sales, returns and purchases (CA ≈ $1B, meaningless). CA alone ≈ $323M purchases + $688M sales.

3. Core concepts

Dimension vs. Measure
Dimension = group by (names, codes, dates), above the gray line. Measure = aggregate (SUM/AVG/COUNT), below the line. Dimensions → GROUP BY, measures → SUM/AVG, like SQL/PivotTable.
Convert ID numbers to dimensions: TR TransNumber, TR Manager, TR EntityID, TR Item, Emp EmployeeID, Ent EntityID, Ent Zip, Mat Material, Prod Product. Keep as measures: TR Quantity, TR UnitPrice, TR Subtotal, TR Tax + 4 calc fields. Hide unused: Emp Order Approval Authority, Ent RelationshipManager.
Test: "Would I ever sum or average this?"
Discrete (blue) vs. Continuous (green)
Blue = headers / separate panes. Green = a real axis (needed for trend lines). Right-click pill → Discrete/Continuous.
Dates: date part vs. truncated
Date part (upper menu options): QUARTER([TR TransDate]) → all Q1s combined, only 4 positions.
Truncated (lower options, show year, e.g. "Q1 2014", "May 2014"): DATETRUNC('quarter',[TR TransDate]) → 16 quarters / 48 months.
Problems 6–10 need truncated quarter (16 points). If the axis shows only Q1–Q4 you picked the wrong one.
Click + on YEAR pill to drill down: year → quarter → month → day.
Marks card: mark type dropdown (Automatic/Bar/Line/Circle/Shape/Map…), Color, Size, Label (prints values), Detail (splits marks finer without new rows/columns), Tooltip (hover text). Show Me (top right) suggests chart types; hover a grayed one to see what it needs.
Filters: drag a field to Filters. Filters remove rows before calculated fields and table calcs (except FIXED LOD, which ignores dimension filters). Exclude nulls: right-click the null mark/header → Exclude, or uncheck Null in the filter. Show a filter on the view: right-click pill → Show Filter.
Axis edits (right-click axis → Edit Axis): rename title; Fixed range ("start at 14K" = Fixed start 14,000); Tick Marks tab (fixed increments, e.g. 1M); Independent axis ranges for each row or column. Same range to compare panes; independent to see change within a pane.

4. How-to recipes (the moves the test checks)

Dual axis
  1. Put 2 measures on Rows.
  2. Right-click the second pill/axis → Dual Axis.
  3. Right-click right axis → Synchronize Axis.
  4. Right-click right axis → uncheck Show Header (hides it).
  5. Set each measure's mark type on its own Marks tab (or the All tab).
  6. If Measure Names lands on Color automatically and you don't want it, drag it off.
  7. Move circles to the front: right-click the axis/pill → Move marks to front, or reorder the pills on Rows.
Quick table calc: Percent of Total
Right-click measure pill → Quick Table Calculation → Percent of Total. Then right-click → Compute Using (or Edit Table Calculation → Specific Dimensions).

5. LOD expressions (Level of Detail)

{ FIXED   [dim1],[dim2] : AGG([measure]) }   own grouping, ignores view
{ INCLUDE [dim]         : AGG([measure]) }   view grouping + dim (finer)
{ EXCLUDE [dim]         : AGG([measure]) }   view grouping − dim (coarser)
{ FIXED : AVG([Sales]) }                      no dims = one grand number
  • Use a colon, not a semicolon. Curly braces.
  • FIXED ignores dimension filters (e.g. NY site filter) and dims in view. INCLUDE/EXCLUDE respect filters.
  • If it shows as ATTR, right-click → Measure → Average.
  • FIXED/INCLUDE finer than view → view takes an average of averages ≠ plain average.

Tutorial 10 examples (view: site, employee, month; filter TransType = O; AVG unit price):

{EXCLUDE [Emp LastName] : AVG([TR UnitPrice])}            site avg per month
{INCLUDE [TR Item] : AVG([TR UnitPrice])}                avg of per-item avgs
{FIXED [TR SiteCode],[TR TransType] : AVG([TR UnitPrice])} flat per site

Ref line Entire Table ≈ 3.347 company avg. EXCLUDE: CA 3.22–3.78, FL 3.16–3.89. INCLUDE: Baro June 2014 → 3.42 (actual 3.57). FIXED: CA 3.518, IL 3.500. TransType in FIXED keeps sales and purchases from mixing. Add MONTH([TR TransDate]) to FIXED to vary by month.

Ref line vs. LOD: ref lines can do per-pane or entire-table averages, but not "each employee vs. their site's average". That needs an LOD.

8. Fast troubleshooting / traps

Percentages don't add to 100% per site → wrong Compute Using. Tick only the dimension you want to run across (material).
Only Q1–Q4 on x-axis → you used date part; switch to truncated quarter (with year).
Record count ≠ 258,602 after joins → an inner join should be left (Material/Product), or the wrong column was matched.
Calc says invalid → check quotes on text, no quotes on numbers, END at the end, brackets match field names, LOD uses colon.
One trend line per employee → uncheck "Allow a trend line per color".
Dual-axis lines on different scales → Synchronize Axis. Extra Measure Names color legend → drag it off Color.
"Company-wide" line changes with the site filter → you didn't use FIXED (or grouped by employee). FIXED ignores dimension filters.
Scatter shows 1 point → turn off Analysis → Aggregate Measures (P11) or add Detail (P12).
Null bar/state shows up → exclude Null (right-click → Exclude) or filter it out.
Filter card has no slider → date must be continuous and set to Range of Dates.

import pandas as pd, numpy as np, sys
pd.set_option('display.width',250)
df=pd.read_parquet(sys.argv[1]); df['Y']=df.TR_TransDate.dt.year
S=(df.TR_TransType=='S')&(df.TR_Subtotal>0)
df['Sales']=np.where(S,df.TR_Subtotal,np.nan); df['Purch']=np.where(df.TR_TransType=='O',df.TR_Subtotal,np.nan)
df['Returns']=np.where(df.TR_Subtotal<0,-df.TR_Subtotal,np.nan)
p=df.pivot_table(index='Mat_MaterialDescription',columns='Y',values='Purch',aggfunc='sum'); print((100*p/p.sum()).round(1))
for y in [2013,2014]:
    t=df[df.Y==y].pivot_table(index='Mat_MaterialDescription',columns='TR_SiteCode',values='Purch',aggfunc='sum'); print(y);print((100*t/t.sum()).round(1))
# purchases by site and year
print((df.pivot_table(index='TR_SiteCode',columns='Y',values='Purch',aggfunc='sum')/1e6).round(1))
print((df.pivot_table(index='TR_SiteCode',columns='Y',values='Sales',aggfunc='sum')/1e6).round(1))
# map min/max per year and all years
for y in [2012,2013,2014,None]:
    d=df if y is None else df[df.Y==y]; st=d.groupby('Ent_State').Purch.sum(); st=st[st>0]
    print('map',y,st.idxmax(),round(st.max()/1e6,2),st.idxmin(),round(st.min()/1e6,2),len(st))
    s=d.groupby('Ent_State').Sales.sum(); s=s[s>0]; print(' salesmap',y,s.idxmax(),round(s.max()/1e6,2),s.idxmin(),round(s.min()/1e6,2),len(s))
# top3 per site per year
for y in [2012,2013,2014,None]:
    d=df if y is None else df[df.Y==y]
    g=d.groupby(['TR_SiteCode','Emp_LastName']).Sales.sum().dropna()
    g=g[g>0]
    print('top3',y,{s:[f"{n} {v/1e6:.2f}" for n,v in x.droplevel(0).sort_values(ascending=False).head(3).items()] for s,x in g.groupby(level=0)})
# top purchasers 2015
g=df[df.Y==2015].groupby(['TR_SiteCode','Emp_LastName']).Purch.sum().dropna(); g=g[g>0]
print('topbuy2015',{s:[f"{n} {v/1e6:.2f}" for n,v in x.droplevel(0).sort_values(ascending=False).head(3).items()] for s,x in g.groupby(level=0)})
# P5 other years compact: totals sales S rows
for y in [2012,2013,2014]:
    s=df[(df.Y==y)&(df.TR_TransType=='S')]; g=s.groupby('TR_SiteCode')
    print('p5',y,pd.DataFrame({'tot':g.TR_Subtotal.sum()/1e6,'avg':g.TR_Subtotal.mean(),'n':g.size(),'cust':g.Ent_EntityID.nunique()}).round(1).to_dict('index'))
# other site averages for P6/P9 2015 avg tx all years
for site in ['CA','FL','IL','TX']:
    d=df[(df.TR_SiteCode==site)&df.Sales.notna()]; q=d.groupby([d.TR_TransDate.dt.to_period('Q'),'Emp_LastName']).Sales
    print(site,'avgtx',round(d.Sales.mean()),'avg of marks',round(q.mean().mean()),'qtr sales ref',round(q.sum().mean()),'emps',sorted(d.Emp_LastName.unique()))
EOF

print((df.pivot_table(index='TR_SiteCode',columns='Y',values='Sales',aggfunc='sum')/1e6).round(1))
# map min/max per year and all years
for y in [2012,2013,2014,None]:
    d=df if y is None else df[df.Y==y]; st=d.groupby('Ent_State').Purch.sum(); st=st[st>0]
    print('map',y,st.idxmax(),round(st.max()/1e6,2),st.idxmin(),round(st.min()/1e6,2),len(st))

# top3 per site per year
for y in [2012,2013,2014,None]:
    d=df if y is None else df[df.Y==y]
    g=d.groupby(['TR_SiteCode','Emp_LastName']).Sales.sum().dropna()
    g=g[g>0]
    print('top3',y,{s:[f"{n} {v/1e6:.2f}" for n,v in x.droplevel(0).sort_values(ascending=False).head(3).items()] for s,x in g.groupby(level=0)})
# top purchasers 2015
g=df[df.Y==2015].groupby(['TR_SiteCode','Emp_LastName']).Purch.sum().dropna(); g=g[g>0]
print('topbuy2015',{s:[f"{n} {v/1e6:.2f}" for n,v in x.droplevel(0).sort_values(ascending=False).head(3).items()] for s,x in g.groupby(level=0)})
# P5 other years compact: totals sales S rows
for y in [2012,2013,2014]:
    s=df[(df.Y==y)&(df.TR_TransType=='S')]; g=s.groupby('TR_SiteCode')
    print('p5',y,pd.DataFrame({'tot':g.TR_Subtotal.sum()/1e6,'avg':g.TR_Subtotal.mean(),'n':g.size(),'cust':g.Ent_EntityID.nunique()}).round(1).to_dict('index'))
# other site averages for P6/P9 2015 avg tx all years
for site in ['CA','FL','IL','TX']:
    d=df[(df.TR_SiteCode==site)&df.Sales.notna()]; q=d.groupby([d.TR_TransDate.dt.to_period('Q'),'Emp_LastName']).Sales
    print(site,'avgtx',round(d.Sales.mean()),'avg of marks',round(q.mean().mean()),'qtr sales ref',round(q.sum().mean()),'emps',sorted(d.Emp_LastName.unique()))

input.new_string:
6b. Question finder: match a new test question to a practice problem

If the question says…Closest problemKey move
"percentage / share of total … for each X"P1Quick Table Calc → Percent of Total
"… broken out by Y, add to 100% for each Y"P2Compute Using → tick only X (the thing that should sum to 100%)
"compare two years side by side / alongside"P3IF YEAR(…) = yyyy THEN … END fields + dual axis, bars vs. circles
"by state / map / color intensity"P4Ent State → filled map, measure on Color, label Min/Max
"for each site show several metrics (total, average, count, distinct …)"P5Many pills on Rows: SUM / AVG / COUNT / COUNTD / ratio calc
"for every employee in [site], by quarter, average …"P6Truncated quarter (green), AVG, Color = employee, site filter, ref line + 1 trend line
"… compared with the company-wide average"P7{FIXED : AVG([…])} + dual axis
"company-wide average for each quarter / month / year"P8{FIXED DATETRUNC('quarter',[TR TransDate]) : AVG([…])}
"total quarterly … per employee"P9Same as P6 but SUM
"company-wide average per employee per quarter"P10Nested LOD: inner FIXED quarter+employee SUM, outer FIXED AVG
"each point is one transaction / do not aggregate"P11Analysis → uncheck Aggregate Measures
"bubble / size = …, aggregate by week (or month)"P12Measures on Columns/Rows/Size, date (truncated) on Detail
"distribution / histogram / frequency of amounts"P13Create → Bins (size N), CNT on Rows
"box and whisker / spread / outliers per customer"P14Show Me box plot, entity on Detail
"top N … per site / within each category"P15Rank table calc, Pane (down), Ctrl-drag rank to Filters
"dashboard / when selected highlight / slider filter"P16Dashboard → Actions → Highlight; filter card → Range of Dates → Apply to both sheets

How to adapt a practice solution to a variation

Variation in the questionWhat to change
Different year (2012/2013/2014) or all yearsChange the YEAR filter value (or remove it); in calc fields change the number: = 2013
Sales instead of purchases (or returns / net sales)Swap the measure pill: Sales / Returns / Net sales / Purchases. For maps of sales use the customer's Ent State.
By product instead of materialUse Prod ProductDescription (sales rows) instead of Mat MaterialDescription (purchase rows) and exclude Null
Per employee instead of per siteReplace TR SiteCode with Emp LastName (or put both); re-check Compute Using
Different site (e.g. CA instead of NY)Change the TR SiteCode filter. FIXED company lines stay the same; only the employee lines change.
By month or year instead of quarterPick the truncated Month / Year on the date pill; LOD: DATETRUNC('month', …)
Top 2 / top 5 / bottom 3Edit the rank filter range; for bottom N, sort ascending or rank ascending
Median / max / count instead of averageRight-click pill → Measure → Median/Max/Count; in LOD swap AVG for MEDIAN/MAX/COUNT
Percent difference / running total / rankQuick Table Calc → that option (then set Compute Using)
Share across the whole table instead of within each siteCompute Using → Table (across then down), or tick both dimensions
Filter action instead of highlightDashboard → Actions → Add Action → Filter (non-selected bars disappear)
Different bin size / axis startEdit the bin field (Edit → size); Edit Axis → Fixed start

Ready answers for the most likely variations

Company-wide % of purchases by material, each year

6b. Question finder: match a new test question to a practice problem

If the question says…Closest problemKey move
"percentage / share of total … for each X"P1Quick Table Calc → Percent of Total
"… broken out by Y, add to 100% for each Y"P2Compute Using → tick only X (the thing that should sum to 100%)
"compare two years side by side / alongside"P3IF YEAR(…) = yyyy THEN … END fields + dual axis, bars vs. circles
"by state / map / color intensity"P4Ent State → filled map, measure on Color, label Min/Max
"for each site show several metrics (total, average, count, distinct …)"P5Many pills on Rows: SUM / AVG / COUNT / COUNTD / ratio calc
"for every employee in [site], by quarter, average …"P6Truncated quarter (green), AVG, Color = employee, site filter, ref line + 1 trend line
"… compared with the company-wide average"P7{FIXED : AVG([…])} + dual axis
"company-wide average for each quarter / month / year"P8{FIXED DATETRUNC('quarter',[TR TransDate]) : AVG([…])}
"total quarterly … per employee"P9Same as P6 but SUM
"company-wide average per employee per quarter"P10Nested LOD: inner FIXED quarter+employee SUM, outer FIXED AVG
"each point is one transaction / do not aggregate"P11Analysis → uncheck Aggregate Measures
"bubble / size = …, aggregate by week (or month)"P12Measures on Columns/Rows/Size, date (truncated) on Detail
"distribution / histogram / frequency of amounts"P13Create → Bins (size N), CNT on Rows
"box and whisker / spread / outliers per customer"P14Show Me box plot, entity on Detail
"top N … per site / within each category"P15Rank table calc, Pane (down), Ctrl-drag rank to Filters
"dashboard / when selected highlight / slider filter"P16Dashboard → Actions → Highlight; filter card → Range of Dates → Apply to both sheets

How to adapt a practice solution to a variation

Variation in the questionWhat to change
Different year (2012/2013/2014) or all yearsChange the YEAR filter value (or remove it); in calc fields change the number: = 2013
Sales instead of purchases (or returns / net sales)Swap the measure pill: Sales / Returns / Net sales / Purchases. For maps of sales use the customer's Ent State.
By product instead of materialUse Prod ProductDescription (sales rows) instead of Mat MaterialDescription (purchase rows) and exclude Null
Per employee instead of per siteReplace TR SiteCode with Emp LastName (or put both); re-check Compute Using
Different site (e.g. CA instead of NY)Change the TR SiteCode filter. FIXED company lines stay the same; only the employee lines change.
By month or year instead of quarterPick the truncated Month / Year on the date pill; LOD: DATETRUNC('month', …)
Top 2 / top 5 / bottom 3Edit the rank filter range; for bottom N, sort ascending or rank ascending
Median / max / count instead of averageRight-click pill → Measure → Median/Max/Count; in LOD swap AVG for MEDIAN/MAX/COUNT
Percent difference / running total / rankQuick Table Calc → that option (then set Compute Using)
Share across the whole table instead of within each siteCompute Using → Table (across then down), or tick both dimensions
Filter action instead of highlightDashboard → Actions → Add Action → Filter (non-selected bars disappear)
Different bin size / axis startEdit the bin field (Edit → size); Edit Axis → Fixed start

6b. Question finder: match a new test question to a practice problem

If the question says…Closest problemKey move
"percentage / share of total … for each X"P1Quick Table Calc → Percent of Total
"… broken out by Y, add to 100% for each Y"P2Compute Using → tick only X (the thing that should sum to 100%)
"compare two years side by side / alongside"P3IF YEAR(…) = yyyy THEN … END fields + dual axis, bars vs. circles
"by state / map / color intensity"P4Ent State → filled map, measure on Color, label Min/Max
"for each site show several metrics (total, average, count, distinct …)"P5Many pills on Rows: SUM / AVG / COUNT / COUNTD / ratio calc
"for every employee in [site], by quarter, average …"P6Truncated quarter (green), AVG, Color = employee, site filter, ref line + 1 trend line
"… compared with the company-wide average"P7{FIXED : AVG([…])} + dual axis
"company-wide average for each quarter / month / year"P8{FIXED DATETRUNC('quarter',[TR TransDate]) : AVG([…])}
"total quarterly … per employee"P9Same as P6 but SUM
"company-wide average per employee per quarter"P10Nested LOD: inner FIXED quarter+employee SUM, outer FIXED AVG
"each point is one transaction / do not aggregate"P11Analysis → uncheck Aggregate Measures
"bubble / size = …, aggregate by week (or month)"P12Measures on Columns/Rows/Size, date (truncated) on Detail
"distribution / histogram / frequency of amounts"P13Create → Bins (size N), CNT on Rows
"box and whisker / spread / outliers per customer"P14Show Me box plot, entity on Detail
"top N … per site / within each category"P15Rank table calc, Pane (down), Ctrl-drag rank to Filters
"dashboard / when selected highlight / slider filter"P16Dashboard → Actions → Highlight; filter card → Range of Dates → Apply to both sheets

How to adapt a practice solution to a variation

Variation in the questionWhat to change
Different year (2012/2013/2014) or all yearsChange the YEAR filter value (or remove it); in calc fields change the number: = 2013
Sales instead of purchases (or returns / net sales)Swap the measure pill: Sales / Returns / Net sales / Purchases. For maps of sales use the customer's Ent State.
By product instead of materialUse Prod ProductDescription (sales rows) instead of Mat MaterialDescription (purchase rows) and exclude Null
Per employee instead of per siteReplace TR SiteCode with Emp LastName (or put both); re-check Compute Using
Different site (e.g. CA instead of NY)Change the TR SiteCode filter. FIXED company lines stay the same; only the employee lines change.
By month or year instead of quarterPick the truncated Month / Year on the date pill; LOD: DATETRUNC('month', …)
Top 2 / top 5 / bottom 3Edit the rank filter range; for bottom N, sort ascending or rank ascending
Median / max / count instead of averageRight-click pill → Measure → Median/Max/Count; in LOD swap AVG for MEDIAN/MAX/COUNT
Percent difference / running total / rankQuick Table Calc → that option (then set Compute Using)
Share across the whole table instead of within each siteCompute Using → Table (across then down), or tick both dimensions
Filter action instead of highlightDashboard → Actions → Add Action → Filter (non-selected bars disappear)
Different bin size / axis startEdit the bin field (Edit → size); Edit Axis → Fixed start

The updated cheat sheet is [MGT153_Tableau_Cheat_Sheet.pdf](MGT153_Tableau_Cheat_Sheet.pdf). It's 9 pages now (it was 6).

**What I added:**
- **Each problem's question:** a green box under every P1–P16 heading gives the question in the problem set's own words, with the build steps and answers right below it.
- **Question finder (§6b):** a table that maps phrases a test question might use, like "share of total… for each," "top N per site," "each point is one transaction" or "slider filter," to the closest practice problem and the key move to make.
- **How to adapt it:** what to change when the question is a variation, such as a different year, sales instead of purchases, product instead of material, per employee instead of per site, month instead of quarter, top 2 or 5, median instead of average, or a filter action instead of highlight.
- **Answers for likely variations,** all computed from your workbook's data:
  - % of purchases by material for 2012, 2013 and 2014
  - % per site for 2013 and 2014 (2012 and 2015 were already in)
  - purchases and sales by site for each year
  - map max and min for every year, plus a sales version of the map
  - top 3 sales employees per site for each year and for all years, plus the top purchasers in 2015
  - P6/P9 reference-line values for every site, not just NY
  - P5 site metrics for 2012, 2013 and 2014

To use it during the quiz, find the question's wording in the question finder, go to that problem, and apply the change from the adapting table.
